claims.summary: A fresh deployed v0.15.33 EduTool.dev AI Governance audit exported successfully, but the ZIP regraded at 98/A because source-ledger proof was missing while the console digest reported 7 retrieved open resources.
proofCommands: Manual EduTool.dev ZIP/log audit saved under verification-output/edutool-audit-loop/20260620T140412Z/

claims.summary: AppFlow adopts generated CourseGraphs synchronously before knowledge-backbone display-map repairs can re-derive a stale graph.

Native stable-id re-derivation preserves matched verified resource metadata such as provider, URL, license, origin, source-finder shard, and reading-list decisions instead of degrading citations into generic syllabus rows.
A focused regression proves an OpenAlex resource survives render -> derive -> match with its source metadata and section resourceRefs intact.
Packages still receive a source-proof finding when no trusted source rows or sourceRef coverage reach the ZIP.

carryForward.next: Build a real ResearchSession planner that researches course concepts once, caches a trusted ledger, and compiles many deliverables without browsing per artifact.
Bridge CourseIR atom sourceRefs directly to retrieved lesson resources so future packages can replace review-only fallback rows with trusted source rows.
Investigate the AI Governance slide-deck repeated-phrase warning separately from the graph handoff/source-proof fix.
